text: If someone knocks on your door tonight... don't open it.
If it happens, follow these rules. Don't skip one.
Rule one. Don't answer. Your voice tells them someone's inside.
Rule two. Don't turn on the light. They can see your shadow under the door.
Rule three. Check the peephole... but don't press your eye against it.
No one's outside. But it knocks again... lower. Like it's coming from the floor.
Rule four. If they say they're the police, or the power company... don't believe them.
This is real. Burglars pose as police, delivery drivers, and utility workers. Call their office yourself.
Rule five. Never say you're alone. Shout: Dad, someone's at the door!
Rule six. The door chain won't save you. One hard push, and it snaps.
Rule seven. Call 911 right away. Don't wait for them to get in.
The knocking stops. Everything goes quiet.
Last rule. The most important one.
When the knocking stops... don't assume they've left.
What would you do first? Comment the rule number.
Send this to a friend who lives alone.
